description: Known defects from a real Express/React code base (reported against quelltest 0.1.0). `expect` is the rule or category quelltest should flag on `line`; null marks a known miss that static line-level rules cannot see.

defects.title: User search crashed on '(' ($regex from user input)
Mobile-number login never matched (+91 not normalised)
Attendance correction accepted any field (Object.assign with req.body)
Simultaneous check-ins gave a misleading duplicate error (exists then create)
Duplicate error always listed four fields
User creation did not validate email/mobile (create(req.body))
Lost refresh response logged the user out
Network blip during refresh logged the user out (call before === in if)
Hour 0 got an invalid React key (|| instead of ??)
Audit page crashed when items missing (data.items.map)
Audit page crashed on an event with no action
